synergy.note: The final hit of Special Attack 2 inflicts a Root Debuff for 3 seconds.

cards.title: Signature Ability GOBLIN KNIGHT
lines: Start each fight with 300.0 Maniacal Charges.
Lunatic Laugh reduces the expiry rate of personal Steadfast and non-Damaging Debuffs by 17.1%.
Hobgoblin's Energy Vulnerability gains +0.8% flat potency.

cards.title: SWORD AND SERUM
lines: Hobgoblin’s perfected Goblin Serum grants him full Immunity to Poison.
Any repeated Light or Medium Attack in a chain of attacks inflicts an Incinerate Debuff dealing 40.0 Energy Damage over 40 seconds.
After Hobgoblin Glances, his flaming sword inflicts a personal Incinerate Debuff. Cooldown: 100.0 second.
This Goblin isn’t so easily shaken. Incoming Deliriums have their durations reduced by -10.0% per Maniacal Charge. Max: 90%.

cards.title: MANIACAL
lines: Hobgoblin’s crazed nature allows him to gain Maniacal Charges lasting 7 seconds, paused while charging a Heavy Attack and during the Opponent’s Special Attacks. These expire one at a time and are refreshed when gaining a new one.
His third Light Attack grants +100.0 Maniacal Charge.
Preventing a Regeneration effect from healing with Heal Block, or Well-Timed Blocking an Unblockable attack with Steadfast grants +100.0 Maniacal Charge. Cooldown: 5 seconds.
While at 1000.0 or more Maniacal Charges, gain an Instinct Passive. Against Mutants, this threshold is -1 or greater.

cards.title: LUNATIC LAUGH
lines: Hobgoblin’s Heavy Attack can be charged for an extended duration.

Charging Hobgoblin's Heavy Attack for 0.5 seconds performs a Lunatic Laugh which rattles the Opponent for -1 seconds, increasing the tick rate of personal Damaging effects on them by 250.0%. The Laugh remains paused while Heavy charging.
Activating a Special Attack 1 or 2 while charging or shortly after starting a Heavy Attack increases the Laugh’s tick rate increase of personal Damaging effects to 500%.

cards.title: MY OWN BAG OF TRICKS
lines: The first hit triggers a non-stacking effect determined by the last Basic Attack landed, whiffed, or charged, each lasting 22 seconds.
Light - inflict a Heal Block Debuff.
Medium - gain a Steadfast Passive.
Heavy - inflict a 10.0 Energy Vulnerability Debuff.
While at 1600.0 or more Maniacal Charges, Hobgoblin's Special Attacks become Passively Unblockable and the first hit triggers all of these effects.

cards.title: SPECIAL ATTACK 1 SP1
lines: Each hit grants +200.0 Maniacal Charges.

cards.title: SPECIAL ATTACK 2 SP2
lines: The final three hits each inflict a 125.0 Incinerate Passive for -1 seconds, with +20% base potency per Maniacal Charge.
At the end of this attack, consume 50% of Maniacal Charges, rounded up. Afterwards, regain 2 Charges if Lunatic Laugh is active.

cards.title: SPECIAL ATTACK 3 SP3
lines: The concussive force of Hobgoblin’s giant Pumpkin Bomb inflicts a Stun Debuff for 3 seconds.
Inflict a non-stacking 600.0 Incinerate Passive for 20 seconds.
Gain +800.0 Maniacal Charges.
